description: This file implements a command-line utility for checking the status of instances in the Cuttlefish Android emulator environment. It parses command-line flags, retrieves configuration data, communicates with launcher processes, and outputs status information in JSON format.

classes.name: StatusFlags
classes.description: Holds command-line flag values for the status command.

methods.name: GetFlagValues
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and returns a StatusFlags object with the parsed values.

methods.name: CalcWebAccessUrl
methods.description: Constructs a web access URL based on server address and device ID.

methods.name: PopulateDevicesInfoFromInstance
methods.description: Creates a JSON object with device information for a specific instance.

methods.name: CvdStatusMain
methods.description: Main logic for the status command; retrieves and outputs status info for instances.
